prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Admin Panel design for React Application
Hello, I need a design for an admin panel (responsive mobile + web design). Requirements: -Design needs to be in dark theme (Figma for the application will be provided for colors, screens, etc.) -Audience for gaming - streamers, content creators, etc. -The application is a React application and uses a lot of MUI components, please try to utilize MUI for most of the design components -Figma file when job is completed for the developer I'm looking for a designer that to work with beyond this job as I will have several design projects in the future. Please let me know if additional information is needed. Screenshots and other requirements will be provided once job is accepted. Thank you
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Live fleet dashboard
client: Ferrylane Freight
client_industry: logistics
start: 2020-09
end: 2020-12
engagement: hourly
stack:
- React
- Socket.IO
- Node.js
- Redis
- Mapbox
built: A dispatcher map showing every truck's position and ETA, pushed to the browser
  as GPS pings arrive.
metrics:
- 1,800 trucks tracked live
- under 2 seconds from ping to screen

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Live fleet dashboard (p02).
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Keep it under 150 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
I’m a passionate, hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building polished web applications.

I’d be glad to help design your dark-themed admin panel for a React app, with a strong focus on responsive mobile and web layouts. I also understand the importance of working within an existing UI system, so I’d aim to utilize MUI components wherever possible and keep the design clean, usable, and consistent for a gaming/creator audience.

In a recent project, I built a live fleet dashboard for Ferrylane Freight using React, Node.js, Socket.IO, Redis, and Mapbox. It tracked 1,800 trucks live and kept updates under 2 seconds from ping to screen.

I’d be happy to collaborate beyond this job as well. Will you be sharing the existing Figma file and screenshots before design work begins?
